meta.name: obviously-awesome
meta.description: Define product positioning by mapping competitive alternatives, unique attributes, and best-fit customers to the right market category. Use when the user mentions "positioning", "competitive alternatives", "how to position", "market category", "positioning canvas", "repositioning", "category creation", "what category are we in", or "why prospects dont get what we do". Also trigger when launching a new product, entering a crowded market, or diagnosing why prospects dont grasp the product's value. Covers the positioning canvas and team workshops. For customer jobs analysis, see jobs-to-be-done. For go-to-market, see crossing-the-chasm.

copy.tagline: 定义产品定位，匹配市场类别与竞争优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为产品寻找市场定位或重新定义品类
copy.tagline_en: Define product positioning by mapping competitive alternatives and market categories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are defining or repositioning your product's market category

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成产品定位：识别竞争替代品、独特属性、最佳客户，并选择市场类别。它会输出定位画布和评分。
howto.when: 当你提到“定位”、“竞争替代品”、“市场类别”等关键词，或要求分析产品定位、推出新产品、进入拥挤市场时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析我们产品的定位，使用定位画布。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写定位画布的10个组件。

say.text: 我们的产品是项目管理工具，如何重新定位？
say.note: Claude 会执行5步定位流程，包括识别替代品和独特属性。

say.text: 评估我们产品当前的定位得分。
say.note: Claude 会给出0-10分并说明改进点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through product positioning: identifying competitive alternatives, unique attributes, best-fit customers, and choosing a market category. It outputs a positioning canvas and a score.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "positioning", "competitive alternatives", "market category", or when launching a new product, entering a crowded market, or diagnosing why prospects don't get the product's value.

say_en.text: Help me analyze our product positioning using the positioning canvas.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the 10 components of the canvas.

say_en.text: Our product is a project management tool. How should we reposition?
say_en.note: Claude will run the 5-step positioning process.
Claude will give a 0-10 score and suggest improvements.
